description: A softer conversation about Bjarne’s childhood curiosity and identity beyond work.

openingMessages.speaker: Mom
openingMessages.text: I came across an old picture of you today. It made me smile.

choices.text: What was I like when I was younger?
You always did enjoy embarrassing me with old pictures.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I'll send it to you later! You were such a curious little boy.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Always taking things apart to figure out how they worked.

choices.text: Do you think I've changed much?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: Oh, you were a handful! You wanted to know absolutely everything.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I remember you taking apart an old radio because you wanted to see how it worked. Your father wasn't particularly happy about that one!

choices.text: Do you think I've changed much?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You always had a knack for making things. I suppose some things never change.

choices.text: Do you think I've changed much?

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: You've accomplished so much, and I'm incredibly proud of you.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: I just wish you'd give yourself a little more time to enjoy what you've accomplished.

lines.speaker: Grand Architect
lines.text: Taking things apart to understand them. A respectable foundation for any engineer.

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: Sounds like we were already violating warranties as a child.

choices.text: I think I needed to hear that.

lines.speaker: Mom
lines.text: That's all I want, sweetheart. Be kind to yourself.
